redemptions_sofar.description: Number of times the group's key has been redeemed. Null if the group has no redemption key, or if the key exists but has not been redeemed yet; otherwise a non-negative integer count of redemptions.

actor.description: Who performed the action (remover, grader, creator, agent, registree or admin), when the log recorded one separately from the entry's user. Always of type user.

type.description:
Reference to an entity as recorded in the log entry. Built from the log snapshot, so it is still returned after
the entity is deleted. `type` values are the ones v1 `gettimeline` uses for `object_*` / `secondary_object_*`.

score.description: Test score (0-100) for unitprogress_test_completion and unitprogress_test_fail; null otherwise.

secondary_object.description: Secondary entity of the event, as v1 secondary_object_id / secondary_object_name.

user.description:
Entities related to a timeline entry.

`user`, `group`, `course`, `branch` and `unit` are the existing v2 slots: they describe live entities and are
null when the event has no such entity or it no longer exists. The keys after them were added for v1 parity and
come from the log snapshot, so they survive deletion.

user_name.description: Name of the entry's user as recorded in the log, still present after the user is permanently deleted.

id.description: Source row ID. Prefixed per source: none (core log), tl_, tcc_, tlpc_, tn_

filtered_by.description: Present only when filters were sent. Keyed by filter name, then operator.
